{{Top|leg}}
A '''snuff box''' or '''snuff container''' was used to hold [[snuff]] on a person. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]] kept a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] snuff container that held fast-acting [[Poison/Legends|poison]] pellets for committing [[Death/Legends|suicide]] in the face of interrogation. [[Weggit Arpor]], an associate of the criminal [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]], also kept a snuff box among his personal items.
